why: The EXPRESS gate (Dan, 28 Sept: 'the express lane ... where there is a big job and a small change'). `suite.mjs --core` = the build pipeline + these checks: the systems every change can break. It must stay a few minutes so a landing never waits; everything else runs in the full suite on the GPU runner after the landing, and a red there opens 'master is red'. A session touching a system may add its own checks here - keep it short.
